title: map pan from centre select jumps listing
rule: Map pan updates from centre; select centres the marker and jumps the listing. Popup snapshot + further-info link; dismiss via close and when another point is selected. Overlapping points → cluster. Filter labels name the input (postcode / suburb / full address).
pass_when: Pan is from centre; selecting a point centres it and moves the listing; popup has a further-info link and dismisses on close or next select; overlaps cluster; filter labels name the input.
fail_when: Select does not update the listing; overlapping points unclustered; unnamed filter inputs.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
